resources.string: A backup is one encrypted file with all members, records and documents. It is protected by a password you choose; without it the file cannot be opened by anyone, including you.
At least 8 characters. Write it down somewhere safe.
The backup could not be written. Choose another location and try again.
Restoring replaces all current members, records and documents with the ones in the backup. Current data is kept if the backup cannot be opened.
That password does not open this backup. Nothing was changed.
This backup file is damaged or incomplete. Nothing was changed.
This is not a MyHealth backup file. Nothing was changed.
This backup was made by a newer version of MyHealth. Update the app first. Nothing was changed.
The file could not be read. Nothing was changed.

MyHealth can read daily steps, heart rate, resting heart rate, sleep and weight that other apps (such as your watch or fitness app) save in Health Connect. It only reads. Daily totals are stored encrypted on this phone, for your own profile, and are never shared.
Install Health Connect from the Play Store to bring in data from your watch or fitness app. Everything else in MyHealth works without it.
Update Health Connect from the Play Store, then come back here.
Health Connect needs Android 9 or later. You can still log vitals by hand.
No permission was given. You can allow access in Health Connect settings at any time.
Health Connect did not respond. Try again later.
Health Connect data belongs to the phone\'s owner, so it is added to your own profile (%1$s).
